firing_adequacy: NOT_ASSESSED; metadata counts are potentials only
release_policy: Resolve official metadata release identifiers once; save verbatim source receipts, URLs without secrets, retrieval UTC and SHA256. Mutable API snapshot is not an immutable physiological release. No later snapshot substitution.
permitted: Unit ID, probe/channel foreign keys and atlas structure labels only
Recording/stimulus start-end intervals, gap/synchronization declarations and trial counts if available as standalone metadata
Behavioral variable names and availability, not behavioral/neural outcomes
Public file version, checksum, size and license declarations
forbidden: Full NWB or mixed physiological archives
Selection based on outcome-derived quality metrics
api_projection: Server-side explicit metadata field projection is mandatory. Fail closed if neural columns are returned. Do not use SDK default unit filtering or download session NWBs.
coverage_rule: Count every returned unfiltered unit with exact CA1, CA3, DG or official DG descendant atlas label. Publish raw labels separately. Units share a session but timestamps/support must independently establish aligned simultaneous observation. Atlas annotations alone do not prove independent histology.
assignment_rule: Only after all metadata admission conditions pass, deterministic SHA256 ordering of eligible mouse identities; first 8 reserved final, remaining development (>=8). No assignment or trial partition fabricated on an unpassed gate. M1 must freeze actual trial partitions before physiology.
pass_conditions: >=16 distinct mice with same-session CA1/DG candidate count>=5 each
Authoritative recording support, stimulus intervals, missingness and alignment
failure_policy: Any unverified mandatory condition makes M0 INCONCLUSIVE, proven inadequate cohort DATA_INSUFFICIENT. Perform one unified metadata-only IBL alternative assessment; do not reduce thresholds. Stop before M1 unless every M0 scientific admission condition passes.
